name: krater_bell_met
object: South Italian (Lucanian) red-figure bell-krater, Pisticci Painter
era_fit: NOT FOR 480 BC CLOSE-UPS - 50-70 years too late and made in southern Italy. The bell-krater SHAPE was already used in Athens by c. 490 BC, so it may stand far in the background as a silhouette; never in focus in a Salamis film. Fine for 430-400 BC stories (Peloponnesian War, Socrates).
use_in: background only for 480 BC; foreground for late-5th-century films
